title: fix(ui): judge requiredWhen as a transition gate on the console form page, the kanban drop prompt and the Edit wizard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY37urno69QP7HQ4DEeF5Fw)_

Fixes #30220

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三处入口都改为按引擎的方式判 `requiredWhen`(转移闸门):控制台表单页(`/forms/:name?recordId=` 编辑)、看板拖放提示、编辑向导的最终提交检查。记录本来就处在闸门内且缺值时,不再拦住无关编辑、不再弹窗索要该字段;把记录移入闸门、清空已有值的编辑照旧拦截。向导按你在 #30220 上裁决的 A 实现:已存记录只交给存量判定,实时判定仍不绑定 `previous`。
- 为什么改:#30216 只修了记录编辑表单;同一条已激活但缺签字件的合同,在表单页保存报「Required: Signed Copy」,看板拖到别的优先级列弹窗索要签字件,编辑向导最后一步提交被拒,而 REST `PATCH` 本身返回 200。
- 风险与回滚:只改客户端判定,读的都是 #30216 已有的存量判定(`requiredWhenAtRest` / `requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord`),没有第二套规则;最坏情况是客户端放行、服务端拒绝,拒绝信息照常显示。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx`(`gateFinalSubmit` 新增的 `isEditWizard && !field.required && requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord(...)` 分支)、`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`(`resolveRowState` 多了 `name: field.name`)、`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`(多了 `name`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/wizardSkipValidation.test.tsx apps/console/src/components/FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx packages/plugin-kanban/src/requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts`,预期全绿,其中三个「…already inside the gate…」用例通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The engine's rule (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`, the "ADR-0113 non-regression: reject iff the MERGED state violates AND the PRE state complied" block, `preViolated`) refuses an update only when the merged record violates `requiredWhen` and the stored row complied. #30216 mirrored that in `@object-ui/core` `resolveFieldRuleState`: given `previous` (the stored row) and `statics.name`, a stored row already inside the gate without the value resolves `required: false` / `requiredWhenAtRest: true`. A caller that passes no `name` keeps the plain verdict, and the stored-row check is exported alone as `requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord`. This PR makes the three remaining doors read it:

- **Console form page** (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, `resolveRowState`): it already passed the stored record (`loaded.record`, the `GET /data/:object/:id` row) as `previous`; it now passes `name: field.name`. The asterisk, `aria-required` and the page's own submit check (`findSubmitRefusals`) all read this one verdict, so all three follow. A create form passes no `previous` and is unchanged.
- **Kanban drop prompt** (`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/requiredWhenPrompt.ts`, `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields`): it already passed the pre-drop record as `previous`; it now passes `name`. A drop of a record already inside the gate without the value issues the plain single-key `PATCH` with no dialog; a drop that moves a compliant record into the gate still opens the "Complete required fields" dialog.
- **Edit wizard** (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx`, `gateFinalSubmit`), as ruled on #30220 (option A, ruling record 6656113078): on an Edit wizard, after the live verdict, a field is skipped when `requiredWhenRestsOnStoredRecord(field.requiredWhen, name, persistedRecord, predicateScope)` answers true and the field is not statically required. The live `resolveFieldRuleState` call still binds no `previous`, so objectui#8069's option-D refusal (no new binding pipeline) and its accepted `visibleWhen` residual are unchanged; `persistedRecord` (the record as first read, the same one the step forms receive as `previousValues`) reaches only the stored-row check, which can only relax a `requiredWhen`, reports no fault, and counts an unevaluable predicate as compliant. The gate's note says so next to the option-D note.

No new rule and no change in `@object-ui/core`. No engine-side door: the engine already implements the gate (the `preViolated` check), so there is no `domain:server` half.

## Why

#30216 fixed the record Edit form only. The same record (a contract activated before its signed-copy rule existed) was still refused by the console form page ("Required: Signed Copy"), prompted for the signed copy by a kanban drop into another priority column, and refused by an Edit wizard's final submit, while REST `PATCH` answers 200 for these writes.

## Tests

- `FormPage.conditionalRules.test.tsx` (the file's existing harness, new top-level describe, real `FormPage` on `/forms/:name?recordId=`): a record already activated with no signed copy shows no required marker and saves an unrelated edit (one `PATCH`, body carries the edit). CONTROL: clearing the value of an activated record that held it is refused (marker shown, `toast.error`, no write).
- `requiredWhenPrompt.test.ts` (new top-level describe): a record already inside the gate dropped into another column of an unrelated grouping collects nothing. CONTROL: a draft dropped into `activated` still collects `signed_copy`.
- `wizardSkipValidation.test.tsx` (the cross-step gate's harness, new top-level describe, real `WizardForm` in edit mode, `allowSkip`, the field on the skipped step so only the gate judges it): an activated record with no signed copy saves an unrelated edit (one `update`). CONTROL: a draft moved to `activated` without the copy is refused, no `update`, and the wizard lands on the step holding the field.

## Acceptance notes

- `Clause-②: no`: `resolveRowState`, `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` and `WizardForm` keep their signatures and props; only the verdict for a stored row already inside the gate changes.
- The wizard leg has unit pins and an ablation but no browser leg: the dispatch asked for browser legs on the kanban and form page doors, which were taken in round 1.
- The after-leg form page shot shows the post-submit record page under the fresh boot's "Set the default currency" dialog; the "Submitted" toast and the `PATCH ... -> 200` reading are the evidence.

<details><summary>Browser check on a dev boot (showcase, fresh, built from this branch at origin/main 31260ca8 + this diff; Vite console serving src)</summary>

Seeded by API as admin: writable package `com.qa.rwgate`, object `rwgate_contract` (status draft/activated, priority low/high, `signed_copy` text) with three rows inserted BEFORE the rule existed, then the object re-saved with `signed_copy.requiredWhen: record.status == 'activated'`; a kanban grouped by priority (default list), a kanban grouped by status (`by_status`), a simple form view, an app.

Engine control on the same boot (REST): `PATCH` the activated row with no signed copy `{priority: high}` answered 200; `PATCH` the draft row `{status: activated}` answered 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` ("Signed Copy is required").

| Leg | Before (fix removed from src, Vite restarted `--force`, served code checked) | After (this branch) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Form page, Edit of the activated row with no signed copy, rename, Submit | label `Signed Copy*`, refused "Required: Signed Copy", no write | label `Signed Copy`, `PATCH /data/rwgate_contract/0zgY… -> 200`, "Submitted" |
| Form page CONTROL, clear the signed copy of a compliant activated row | refused, no write | refused, no write (label `Signed Copy*`) |
| Kanban by priority, drag the activated row with no signed copy Low to High | "Complete required fields" dialog, no write | no dialog, `PATCH ... -> 200`, card in High |
| Kanban by status CONTROL, drag the draft row Draft to Activated | dialog asks for Signed Copy | dialog asks for Signed Copy, no write |

Shots: `/mnt/project-files/ui-orders/30220-shots/` (`before-1..4`, `after-1..4`, one per leg). The boot and the Vite server were stopped after the run (health 000).
